### workspace reactivate --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace reactivate [options] [project]

Reactivate Claude in a project's tmux pane with 'claude --continue || claude'.
Auto-detects the project from the current directory if not specified.

Options:
        --all                        Reactivate Claude in all active projects
        --json                       Print one action document (see docs/README.json.md) instead of text, which goes to stderr

Examples:
  workspace reactivate my-project    # reactivate Claude in a specific project
  workspace reactivate    # auto-detected from the current directory
  workspace reactivate --all    # reactivate Claude in all active projects
--- stderr
--- end
